title: TriCap asks $100M for 800 Lincoln Road retail building in Miami Beach
summary: Newmark is marketing the 32,100-SF, three-story 800 Lincoln Road, home to Lululemon and Mila, at a $100M ask, or $3,111 per SF. TriCap paid $88.2M ($2,744 per SF) in 2015 and redeveloped the building. Nearby, 930 Lincoln Road sold for $22M last week and 318-334 Lincoln Road for $18.4M last month.

title: AHPC buys 1,086-bed FIU-area student housing from Toll Brothers for $168.5M
summary: Nonprofit Affordable Housing Preservation Corp. bought the 21-story, 293-unit Lapis in Sweetwater for $168.5M, or $575,085 per unit, financed with about $193.9M of Public Finance Authority bonds. AHPC will operate it as student, faculty and staff housing and transfer it to FIU once the bonds are repaid. Toll Brothers completed the building in 2023.

title: Billionaire VC Hemant Taneja linked to record $48.5M Venetian Islands mansion
summary: Hemant Taneja, CEO of General Catalyst, is the buyer of a 10,700-SF waterfront estate on North Venetian Way, San Marco Island, per The Real Deal. The $48.5M sale topped the $47.5M ask and set a record for the Venetian Islands and San Marco. The seven-bedroom house sits on 0.3 acre with 103 feet of water frontage; sellers paid $6M in 2021. Furniture was included.

title: Top deals: 100-year-old Palm Island mansion sells for $29M; West Palm warehouse $27.5M
summary: TRD's Oct. 14 digest: an 11,300-SF Palm Island mansion at 49 Palm Avenue in Miami Beach traded for $29M ($2,565/SF), last sold for $4.9M in 2004, with a $27.7M JPMorgan Chase mortgage. Meso Scale Diagnostics paid $27.5M ($327/SF) for an 84,000-SF West Palm Beach warehouse, and a Rivo Alto Island home sold for $17.2M ($3,406/SF).

title: BKM Capital spends $174M on three Florida industrial deals in three weeks
summary: California-based BKM Capital Partners paid $14M ($230/SF) for the 61,100-SF Palm Crossing South in Fort Lauderdale and $57M ($270/SF) with Kayne Anderson for the 210,000-SF Lakeview Center, plus $103M ($190/SF) for a 543,000-SF Orlando portfolio. JLL says Broward industrial rents reached $17.10/SF NNN, up 4.1% YoY, with 158,500 SF absorbed in Q3 despite slower leasing and investment activity.

title: Boca Raton spec mansion at 1520 Royal Palm Way finds buyer at ~$31.8M ask
summary: SRD Building's nearly 8,600-SF waterfront estate in Royal Palm Yacht & Country Club, asking about $31.8M ($3,710/SF), was the priciest Palm Beach County contract of Oct. 5-11. Per Douglas Elliman's Eklund Gomes team, buyers signed 12 contracts of $3M+ totaling about $112.3M in asking volume, versus 12 contracts and $96M the prior week.

title: David Martin's Terra Lands $183.8M Monroe Capital Refi on The Well Bay Harbor Islands Offices
summary: Terra refinanced the 96,000-SF office building it completed this summer at The Well Bay Harbor Islands with $183.8M from Monroe Capital's real estate platform (Walker & Dunlop arranged). The office is 90% leased, including Tom Brady's TEB Capital (8,400 SF) and Dwight Capital (23,000 SF). A partial release of the prior $238M Eldridge/Hudson Bay loan was recorded Tuesday. Boutique waterfront office-plus-condo projects are drawing out-of-state financial tenants.

title: MRK Partners Lands $67M Berkadia Financing for 164-Unit Fort Lauderdale Affordable Redevelopment
summary: MRK Partners secured $67M in construction-to-permanent financing ($50M tax-exempt, $17M taxable, about $408,540 per unit) from Berkadia to replace 88 1950s units with 164 affordable apartments in two five-story buildings on 3.7 acres in Progresso, Fort Lauderdale. The project extends the property's Section 8 HAP contract through 2046 amid a 74,100-unit Broward affordable-housing shortfall.

title: Russell Galbut Scraps Three Miami Beach Live Local Act Projects, ~400 Units, After Backlash
summary: Crescent Heights/GFO developer Russell Galbut withdrew three Live Local Act proposals in South Beach (1575 Alton Rd, 740 Alton Rd, 880 71st St) after opposition from city and county commissioners; he says he still backs the law and other Beach projects. Miami Beach commissioners were set to weigh possible legal action against the state law, signaling rising local pushback on Live Local density bonuses.

title: Dania Beach Nursing Home Sells for $16.6M, $800/SF; Miami Beach Mansion Trades at $21.5M
summary: Tordjman Equities-tied buyer acquired the 88-bed, 20,758-SF Westlake Nursing and Rehab Center at 440 Phippen-Waiters Road for $16.6M, or $800/SF, per TRD; the deed price may exclude business assets. Separately, a six-bedroom, 3,464-SF waterfront home at 6500 Allison Road in Miami Beach sold off-market for $21.5M, or $995/SF, with 100 feet of ocean frontage on a half-acre lot.

title: Rock Soffer Sells Wynwood Site at 127-135 NW 24th St for $6.5M, With $4M Seller Financing
summary: An entity tied to David Ederhy bought the 14,500-SF site for $6.5M, with the seller providing $4M in financing maturing September 2028. It expands the buyer's Wynwood assemblage to 0.7 acres, with a combined cost of $14.7M. Soffer paid $13.1M in late 2022 for a planned mixed-use hotel that did not pencil out on the smaller site.

title: Trinity Southern Lands $19.5M S3 Capital Loan for 29 Indian Creek Condos in Miami Beach
summary: S3 Capital provided a $19.5M construction loan, arranged by CBRE, for the 16-unit 29 Indian Creek at 2901 Indian Creek Drive near the Faena District. Presales exceed 70%, with prices from $1.5M to over $8M and completion expected in 2027. The seller transferred the 15,000-SF site for $8M the day the loan closed. Developers face higher borrowing costs after the Fed's latest rate hike.

title: Vanderbilt Raises $400M of $520M Goal for 8-Acre West Palm Beach Campus
summary: Vanderbilt University has raised $400M toward a $520M goal for its West Palm Beach graduate campus, per TRD citing the Palm Beach Post. The 300,000-SF campus on 8 acres is slated to start construction next year and open in 2029 with about 1,000 students. Jeff Greene donated 1.3 acres valued near $80M, and Steve Ross pledged $50M.

title: Safe Harbor Takes Miami Beach's Tides Hotel, Lands $44M Maxim Loan
summary: Safe Harbor Capital Partners secured a $44 million mortgage from Maxim Credit Group on the 45-room Tides Hotel at 1220 Ocean Drive and adjacent Collins Ave properties. It acquired the asset by credit bid at a March foreclosure auction against Chetrit Group, which is appealing a $95.6 million judgment. The renovated hotel is slated to reopen next month; the owner would consider a sale at the right price.

title: Baptist Health Buys Coral Gables Office Building for $39M, $321/SF
summary: Baptist Health South Florida bought 2855 Le Jeune Road from City National Bank for $39 million, about $321 per square foot, per records and Vizzda. The four-story 2007 building sits on 0.7 acres with a bank branch and 32,300 SF of offices. The bank sold after leasing 145,000 SF for its headquarters nearby. Health systems are competing for South Florida sites.

title: Dutch Corendon Pays $50M-Plus for Two South Beach Art Deco Hotels
summary: Corendon Hotels & Resorts made its first US hotel investment, paying over $50 million in one transaction for Aloha Friday's at 944 Collins Ave and the Beach Plaza Hotel at 1401 Collins Ave. The properties hold 97 and 95 rooms and are being rebranded. The seller paid $16.6M in 2024 and $26.5M in 2023. Berkadia's Jennifer Jin represented the seller, extending a trend of European buyers in Miami Beach hotels.
